$description: Form component tokens — shared by every form control (checkbox, radio, switch, input, textarea, select) and the `l-form-field` wrapper. Two families: `form.control.*` (control appearance) and `form.field.*` (field layout). References semantic aliases so theming/dark-mode is inherited.

activated-color.$description: Color of a control when activated (checked checkbox, selected radio, on switch). Form-wide accent, akin to native `accent-color`. A stable, saturated color that does not invert between light and dark, so the baked white glyph stays legible in both modes — override per brand.

activated-content-color.$description: Color of the glyph on the activated fill (checkmark, radio dot, switch thumb). Pairs with the stable accent.

background-color.$description: Control background (input, textarea, select, unchecked toggle box).

value-color.$description: Color of the user-entered value text.

toggle-size.$description: Box size of toggle controls (checkbox, radio, switch). Relative to font size so it scales with the label.

height.$description: Height of text controls (input, select, textarea).

required-content.$description: Marker appended to a required field's label.

gap.$description: Vertical gap between label, control, and messages in a stacked field.

choice-gap.$description: Horizontal gap between a toggle control and its label in an inline field.
